say:1:1422103001:0.text: If you have anything to say, please say it in front of both of us.
say:1:1422103001:0.source_cn: 有什么事就当着我们两人的面说吧。

say:2:1422103002:0.text: Merlin is someone I trust deeply. If this discussion relates to my authority over the guards, I'd prefer him to be present to advise me on certain matters...
say:2:1422103002:0.source_cn: 梅林是我可以信赖之人，如果你想跟我谈的事涉及卫队职权，...
say:2:1422103002:0.male: Merlin is someone I trust deeply. If this discussion relates to my authority over the guards, I'd prefer him to be present to advise me on certain matters...
say:2:1422103002:0.female: Merlin is someone I trust deeply. If this discussion relates to my authority over the guards, I'd prefer her to be present to advise me on certain matters...

say:3:1422103003:0.text: ... Alright, Captain Indris. I'm here to report a crime on behalf of Lady Rosalind. Our young master is missing, and we've already searched every corner of the royal city but have not found him.
say:3:1422103003:0.source_cn: ……好吧，因度厄大人，我是替罗莎琳德夫人来报案的！我家...

say:4:1422103004:0.text: I need more details, such as his whereabouts before his disappearance, when you think he went missing, and the place where he was last seen.
say:4:1422103004:0.source_cn: 案情细节是怎样的？我需要知道你家少爷失踪前的轨迹、失踪...

say:5:1422103005:0.text: As a servant, I cannot provide the details you need. However, my lady would personally like to discuss these matters with you face-to-face.
say:5:1422103005:0.source_cn: ……作为仆从说这些实在是僭越，关于案件的内情，我家夫人...

say:6:1422103006:0.text: Would you like to accompany me, Merlin?
say:6:1422103006:0.source_cn: 梅林，不介意陪我走一趟吧？
say:6:1422103006:0.male: Would you like to accompany me, Merlin?
say:6:1422103006:0.female: Would you like to accompany me, Merlin?

choice_prompt:7:1422103006.text: Would you like to accompany me, Merlin?
choice_prompt:7:1422103006.source_cn: 梅林，不介意陪我走一趟吧？
choice_prompt:7:1422103006.male: Would you like to accompany me, Merlin?
choice_prompt:7:1422103006.female: Would you like to accompany me, Merlin?

say:8:1422103008:0.source_cn: 那么二位大人，请随我来吧。

choice:7:0:1.source_cn: 我也好奇会有什么内情

choice:7:1:2.text: Would I be paid for my services?
choice:7:1:2.source_cn: 多给点劳务费就不介意
choice:7:1:2.male: Would I be paid for my services?
choice:7:1:2.female: Would I be paid for my services?

say:1:1422104001:1.text: Ah, yes, our captain of the guard is here. And who is this with you...?
say:1:1422104001:1.source_cn: ……啊，是我们的卫队长来了，还有这位是……？

choice_prompt:2:1422104001.text: Ah, yes, our captain of the guard is here. And who is this with you...?
choice_prompt:2:1422104001.source_cn: ……啊，是我们的卫队长来了，还有这位是……？

say:3:1422104002:1.text: Ah, so you're his confidant. I had wondered about his situation before... Anyway, welcome, please make yourself at home.
say:3:1422104002:1.source_cn: 既然是因度厄的心腹，就请自便吧。
say:3:1422104002:1.male: Ah, so you're his confidant. I had wondered about his situation before... Anyway, welcome, please make yourself at home.
say:3:1422104002:1.female: Ah, so you're his confidante. I had wondered about his situation before... Anyway, welcome, please make yourself at home.

say:4:1422104004:1.text: I've asked you to come today, Indris, because there is a delicate family matter I need your help with... My son, Viscount Lolde, has been missing for an entire week.
say:4:1422104004:1.source_cn: 因度厄，我请你前来，是有一桩家事不得不向你求助……我的...

say:6:1422104005:1.text: Yes, your maid told me as much. I need more information, such as where was he when he disappeared? Did anything unusual happen before his disappearance?
say:6:1422104005:1.source_cn: 我需要更多的信息，比如他失踪的地点？失踪之前有没有什么...

say:7:1422104006:1.text: Well, everything seemed normal. However, before his disappearance, someone witnessed a servant trying to lure him to the commoners' district.
say:7:1422104006:1.source_cn: 他失踪之前……一切如常，不过有人目击到，失踪之前曾经有...

say:10:1422104008:0.text: It was me...! Captain Indris, I-I saw it... I swear it's the truth!
say:10:1422104008:0.source_cn: ……！是、是我！夫人，因度厄大人，我看到了……千真万确！

say:11:1422104009:1.text: We've searched the entire royal city and still can't find him. The only explanation is that he was taken to the commoners' district.
say:11:1422104009:1.source_cn: 我的人已经搜寻了王城的每一寸角落，都没有找到他。所以只...

say:13:1422104011:0.text: Someone of his stature? No chance he'd set foot in a place like that by choice!
say:13:1422104011:0.source_cn: 以他尊贵的身份，怎么可能自愿去那种地方！

say:14:1422104012:1.text: Captain, I need you to go to the <style="stress">commoners' district</style> and find Lolde. This must be kept under wraps—no one can know about it, or it could harm our reputation.
say:14:1422104012:1.source_cn: 因度厄，我要你前往<style=stress>平民区<...

say:15:1422104013:1.text: Your task is to bring back my son, not to investigate what happened. Do you understand what I need from you?
say:15:1422104013:1.source_cn: 我给你的任务是把我的儿子带回来，而不是调查真相，你明白...

say:17:1422104015:1.text: Well then... Seya, please help me see our guests off.

say:19:1422104003:1.text: I had wondered... Anyway, anyone so trusted by Captain Indris is welcome. Please make yourself at home.
say:19:1422104003:1.source_cn: ……既然是因度厄信任之人，就请自便吧。
say:19:1422104003:1.male: I had wondered... Anyway, anyone so trusted by Captain Indris is welcome. Please make yourself at home.
say:19:1422104003:1.female: I had wondered... Anyway, anyone so trusted by Captain Indris is welcome. Please make yourself at home.

say:0:1422105001:0.text: What do you think is the truth of this matter?
say:0:1422105001:0.source_cn: 你觉得觉得这件事的真相如何？
say:0:1422105001:0.male: What do you think is the truth of this matter?
say:0:1422105001:0.female: What do you think is the truth of this matter?

say:1:1422105002:0.text: There's more layers behind the noble lady's words... Let's ask our so-called witness about it.
say:1:1422105002:0.source_cn: 这位夫人话中有话……问问所谓的“证人”吧。
say:1:1422105002:0.male: There's more layers behind the noble lady's words... Let's ask our so-called witness about it.
say:1:1422105002:0.female: There's more layers behind the noble lady's words... Let's ask our so-called witness about it.

say:1:1422106001:0.text: You mentioned seeing a servant trying to lure Lord Lolde to the commoners' district? What did the servant look like, and how did they try to convince him to go?
say:1:1422106001:0.source_cn: 你说你目击到有仆从试图诱骗洛尔迪子爵？是怎样的仆从？用...

say:2:1422106002:1.text: Captain, my lady has already told you everything I know! Other than what she has said, I don't know anything else!
say:2:1422106002:1.source_cn: ……大人，刚刚夫人说的就是我所知道的一切！除此之外我什...

choice_prompt:3:1422106002.text: Captain, my lady has already told you everything I know! Other than what she has said, I don't know anything else!
choice_prompt:3:1422106002.source_cn: ……大人，刚刚夫人说的就是我所知道的一切！除此之外我什么都不知道！

say:5:1422106005:0.text: The most important thing right now is to find Lord Lolde. The longer we delay, the more dangerous his situation becomes. Only by knowing the truth of what happened can we find him faster.
say:5:1422106005:0.source_cn: 如今最重要的是找到失踪的洛尔迪，耽搁越久，他的处境就越...

choice_prompt:6:1422106005.text: The most important thing right now is to find Lord Lolde. The longer we delay, the more dangerous his situation becomes. Only by knowing the truth of what happened can we find him faster.
choice_prompt:6:1422106005.source_cn: 如今最重要的是找到失踪的洛尔迪，耽搁越久，他的处境就越危险。只有知道究竟发生了什么，才能更快找到他。

say:7:1422106006:1.text: Alright, but please don't tell Lady Rosalind what I said. Actually... Lord Lolde was never lured to the commoner's district.
say:7:1422106006:1.source_cn: 好吧……千万不要让夫人知道是我说的！其实我根本没有目击...
say:7:1422106006:1.male: Alright, but please don't tell Lady Rosalind what I said. Actually... Lord Lolde was never lured to the commoner's district.
say:7:1422106006:1.female: Alright, but please don't tell Lady Rosalind what I said. Actually... Lord Lolde was never lured to the commoner's district.

say:8:1422106007:1.text: However, he did go there... My guess is he followed Elsa...
say:8:1422106007:1.source_cn: 但洛尔迪少爷应该真的去了平民区……我猜他是跟随艾莎去的……

say:10:1422106009:1.text: Don't get me wrong! Elsa is not a bad person! She's just an ordinary servant working in my lady's household like me, but... she's also Lord Lolde's lover.
say:10:1422106009:1.source_cn: 别误会，艾莎不是坏人！她和我一样是在夫人家干活的普通仆...

say:11:1422106010:0.text: They fell in love. Lord Lolde and Elsa thought they hid it well enough, but it wasn't long before they were discovered by Lady Rosalind.
say:11:1422106010:0.source_cn: 洛尔迪少爷和艾莎相爱了，他们自以为隐藏得很好，可没过多...

say:12:1422106011:0.text: A noble viscount falling for a servant? My lady couldn't let such a scandal unfold. When Elsa went to collect the Divine Dew, she was beaten by those my lady sent.
say:12:1422106011:0.source_cn: 尊贵的子爵竟会爱上仆从……夫人无法允许这种丑闻发生，于...

say:13:1422106012:0.text: Afterward, she was marked with a Stigma of Judgment and expelled from the royal city...!
say:13:1422106012:0.source_cn: 之后直接被施加惩罚印记逐出了王城……！

say:14:1422106013:0.text: Lord Lolde disappeared soon after learning about this. I talked to the other servants, and someone saw him collecting the Divine Dew in person...
say:14:1422106013:0.source_cn: 得知这些的洛尔迪少爷不久就失踪了，我问过别的仆从，有人...

say:15:1422106014:0.text: I think he was worried about Elsa, so he went to the commoners' district.
say:15:1422106014:0.source_cn: 我想他肯定是担心艾莎的安危，于是也去了平民区！

say:16:1422106015:0.text: Captain Indris, please, I'm begging you to show Elsa some mercy. She's not a criminal. She's just a child from a poor family, like me.
say:16:1422106015:0.source_cn: 因度厄大人，我恳求您对艾莎网开一面，她不是罪犯，她和我...

say:17:1422106016:0.text: Because of their relationship, she has paid a heavy price...
say:17:1422106016:0.source_cn: 因为这段恋情，她已经付出了沉重的代价……

say:18:1422106017:0.text: Well, we need to find them both as soon as possible first.
say:18:1422106017:0.source_cn: 前提是我们需要尽快找到她和洛尔迪。

say:19:1422106018:0.text: You're more familiar with Elsa and Lord Lolde than we are. Are you willing to help us?
say:19:1422106018:0.source_cn: 你比我们熟悉艾莎和洛尔迪的情况，你愿意协助我找到他们吗？

say:20:1422106019:0.text: Yes! I'll do what I can!

choice:6:0:1.text: We won't tell the lady what you said.
choice:6:0:1.source_cn: 我们不会向夫人透露你说的一切
choice:6:0:1.male: We won't tell the lady what you said.
choice:6:0:1.female: We won't tell the lady what you said.

say:23:1422106004:0.text: But my lady instructed me not to...
say:23:1422106004:0.male: But my lady instructed me not to...
say:23:1422106004:0.female: But my lady instructed me not to...

choice:3:1:2.source_cn: 我们都知道刚才夫人有所隐瞒

say:0:1422107001:0.text: The commoners' district is too big. We need to ask some people to get some intel first.
say:0:1422107001:0.source_cn: 平民区太大，得先找几个人问问消息。

say:2:1422108001:0.text: While you were on duty recently, did you let anyone pass from the royal city into the commoners' district?
say:2:1422108001:0.source_cn: 你最近执勤的时候时有没有放行从王城来到平民区的人？

say:3:1422108002:0.text: Captain! Except for the servants expelled from the royal city, no suspicious individuals were allowed to pass! Wait! No... There was one noble...
say:3:1422108002:0.source_cn: 报告大人！除了那些被驱赶出王城的仆从外，绝对没有放行任...

say:4:1422108003:0.text: He claimed to a viscount and was chasing after a runaway servant... I did not dare stop him. A thousand apologies, Captain. I should've kept him out...
say:4:1422108003:0.source_cn: 那个人穿着贵族服饰，说他是一位子爵，正在追赶家里的逃奴...

say:5:1422108004:0.text: It's alright. I understand. As you were.

say:1:1422109001:0.text: Have you seen a noble in the commoners' district lately?
say:1:1422109001:0.source_cn: 你最近有没有在平民区见过一个穿贵族服饰的人？

say:2:1422109002:0.text: Ha! You must be joking! How can there be a noble in the commoners' district? But, Captain, in my heart, you're worth ten nobles!
say:2:1422109002:0.source_cn: 这您可就说笑了，平民区怎么会有贵族！因度厄大人，您就是...

say:4:1422109003:0.text: Well then, have you seen a girl named Elsa?
say:4:1422109003:0.source_cn: 那你有没有见到一个叫艾莎的平民女孩？

say:5:1422109004:0.text: Elsa? Yeah, I know Elsa. Orphan, right? Small and skinny? Heard she got lucky and went off to live the good life in the royal city. Why can't stuff like that happen to me?
say:5:1422109004:0.source_cn: 艾莎？艾莎我知道啊，我记得是个孤儿来着，长得瘦瘦小小，...

say:6:1422109005:1.text: Captain, you got any other questions? I'm sure I can help you.
say:6:1422109005:1.source_cn: 大人，要不您再问我点别的？我保准知道！

choice_prompt:7:1422109005.text: Captain, you got any other questions? I'm sure I can help you.
choice_prompt:7:1422109005.source_cn: 大人，要不您再问我点别的？我保准知道！

choice:7:0:1.text: We'll find you if we need help again.
choice:7:0:1.male: We'll find you if we need help again.
choice:7:0:1.female: We'll find you if we need help again.

say:3:1422110002:0.text: Oh! If it isn't the captain of the guards! I was just kidding! Talking to myself, that's all. Do you remember me? When you were still here in the commoners' district, I...
say:3:1422110002:0.source_cn: 你……？啊，这不是卫队长大人嘛！我说着玩的！你还记得我...

say:4:1422110003:0.text: Yes, yes. Have you seen a girl named Elsa? Or someone wearing a noble's clothing?
say:4:1422110003:0.source_cn: 你有没有见过一个叫艾莎的女孩？或者穿贵族服饰的人？

say:5:1422110004:1.text: Elsa... I've never met a girl named Elsa. But someone wearing a noble's clothing, yeah! He had the nerve to line up and collect Divine Dew in that outfit!
say:5:1422110004:1.source_cn: 艾莎……没见过什么叫艾莎的。要说穿贵族衣服的，还真见了...

say:6:1422110005:1.text: There's already not enough Divine Dew in the commoners' district. The nobles in the royal city have all they could ever want, and now they're coming here to take ours too!
say:6:1422110005:1.source_cn: 平民区的灵露本来就不够分，城里的贵族老爷有喝不完的灵露...

choice_prompt:7:1422110005.text: There's already not enough Divine Dew in the commoners' district. The nobles in the royal city have all they could ever want, and now they're coming here to take ours too!
choice_prompt:7:1422110005.source_cn: 平民区的灵露本来就不够分，城里的贵族老爷有喝不完的灵露，现在反倒跑到我们的地盘来分灵露了！

say:8:1422110006:1.text: What do you think happened? A bunch of hot-headed guys jumped him and chased him off. Guys like him need a good beating every now and then.
say:8:1422110006:1.source_cn: 还能怎么样，被……几个血气方刚的年轻人打了一顿，赶走了...
say:8:1422110006:1.male: What do you think happened? A bunch of hot-headed guys jumped him and chased him off. Guys like him need a good beating every now and then.
say:8:1422110006:1.female: What do you think happened? A bunch of hot-headed guys jumped him and chased him off. Guys like him need a good beating every now and then.

say:9:1422110007:1.text: Hey, don't look at me! I didn't do anything! I just watched, okay?!
say:9:1422110007:1.source_cn: 别、别看我！我没动手！我就凑热闹，在旁边看了一眼！
say:9:1422110007:1.male: Hey, don't look at me! I didn't do anything! I just watched, okay?!
say:9:1422110007:1.female: Hey, don't look at me! I didn't do anything! I just watched, okay?!

say:10:1422110008:1.text: Which direction did he go in?

say:11:1422110009:1.text: He went to the woodland area in the southeast...
say:11:1422110009:1.source_cn: 好像是东南方向的林、林地吧……

say:0:1422111001:0.text: Lord Lolde went deep into the forest...
say:0:1422111001:0.source_cn: 洛尔迪往林地深处去了……

say:0:1422111101:0.source_cn: 那个人说的应该是这里。

say:1:1422111102:0.text: Let's look for clues along the way.

say:0:1422112001:0.text: Are these notes of some sort?
say:0:1422112001:0.source_cn: 这里有几张……手记的残页？

say:0:1422113001:0.text: This mentions a camp. Let's check the camp ahead of us!
say:0:1422113001:0.source_cn: 信里提到了营地，我们去前面的营地找找！

say:1:1422115001:1.text: Lord Lolde! We finally found you! Come back with us!
say:1:1422115001:1.source_cn: 少爷！终于找到您了，跟我们回去吧！

say:2:1422115002:1.text: I know my mother sent you all to find me... I'm afraid I'll have to disappoint you. I have no plans of returning.
say:2:1422115002:1.source_cn: 我知道你们是母亲派来找我的……恐怕要让你们失望了，我不...

say:4:1422115003:1.text: We know about you and Elsa. Where is she? Would you be willing to return if we remove the Stigma from her?
say:4:1422115003:1.source_cn: 我们知道你和艾莎的事了，艾莎现在在哪？如果为她消除印记...

say:5:1422115004:1.text: Ha... Remove the Stigma... Unfortunately, it's too late for that.
say:5:1422115004:1.source_cn: 呵……消除印记……可惜一切都太晚了。

say:0:1422120001:0.text: Yes, the bridge by the water...
say:0:1422120001:0.source_cn: 水边的廊桥，就是这里了。

say:1:1422120101:0.text: Magister, Elsa's ring seems to be reacting to something!
say:1:1422120101:0.male: Magister, Elsa's ring seems to be reacting to something!
say:1:1422120101:0.female: Magister, Elsa's ring seems to be reacting to something!

choice_prompt:2:1422120101.text: Magister, Elsa's ring seems to be reacting to something!
choice_prompt:2:1422120101.source_cn: <male>先生</male><female>女士</female>，艾莎的戒指好像有反应！
choice_prompt:2:1422120101.male: Magister, Elsa's ring seems to be reacting to something!
choice_prompt:2:1422120101.female: Magister, Elsa's ring seems to be reacting to something!

say:8:1422120104:0.text: My sweet Lolde, you've made me happier than I've ever been...
say:8:1422120104:0.source_cn: 洛尔迪，我从没有像现在这样幸福过……

say:9:1422120105:0.text: Every day with you feels like a warm, fluffy dream...
say:9:1422120105:0.source_cn: 和你在一起的每一天，都像生活在巨大的肥皂泡幻影里……

say:10:1422120106:0.text: You don't make me feel like a lowly servant but a real woman of flesh and blood!
say:10:1422120106:0.source_cn: 你让我觉得，我不再是卑贱的仆从，被随意驱使的杂役，无足...

say:11:1422120107:0.text: After all these years of working tirelessly in this vast city, I've finally left a mark—not on the streets or the skyline, but with you, in your heart.
say:11:1422120107:0.source_cn: 在这偌大的、我为之不停劳作的王城里，我第一次留下了存在...

say:12:1422120108:0.text: But how long will these happy, careless days last...? I dare not think about it.
say:12:1422120108:0.source_cn: 可这样幸福的日子会持续多久呢……？我不敢细想。

say:13:1422120109:0.text: You once asked me if I cared about all things that stand in our way... Yes, I care and fear for our future...
say:13:1422120109:0.source_cn: 你曾经问过我，是否还介意那些阻挡我们的东西？其实我介意...

say:14:1422120110:0.text: We come from different worlds, you and I. And trust me, I know better than you what happens to those of low birth who dare to love the nobility. It's a path I wouldn't wish on anyone.
say:14:1422120110:0.source_cn: 我和你生活在不一样的世界里，我比你更清楚那些和贵族恋爱...

say:16:1422120112:0.text: Oh, my sweet Lolde, until death takes me and makes us part ways...
say:16:1422120112:0.source_cn: 洛尔迪，直到死亡把我带走，把我们分开之前……

say:17:1422120113:0.text: Let a piece of me linger in your heart... A whisper of forever...
say:17:1422120113:0.source_cn: 在你心里，留下我存在过的痕迹吧……

say:20:1422120114:0.text: Oh, Elsa never regretted any of it...
say:20:1422120114:0.source_cn: 原来艾莎从来没有后悔过……
say:20:1422120114:0.male: Oh, Elsa never regretted any of it...
say:20:1422120114:0.female: Oh, Elsa never regretted any of it...

say:21:1422120115:0.text: Let us leave the ring here... in this place.
say:21:1422120115:0.source_cn: 我们把这枚戒指……留在这里吧。
say:21:1422120115:0.male: Let us leave the ring here... in this place.
say:21:1422120115:0.female: Let us leave the ring here... in this place.

choice:4:0:1.source_cn: 它无意间记录了主人最强烈的记忆

choice:2:0:1.text: The magic on the ring is connected here.
choice:2:0:1.source_cn: 戒指上残留的魔力对这里有感应
choice:2:0:1.male: The magic on the ring is connected here.
choice:2:0:1.female: The magic on the ring is connected here.

cinematic_dialogue:2:1422116002:.text: Get away from her! She's corrupted!
cinematic_dialogue:2:1422116002:.source_cn: 让开！洛尔迪！她已经孽化了！

cinematic_dialogue:2:1422116003:.text: I won't let anyone hurt her again!
cinematic_dialogue:2:1422116003:.source_cn: 我不允许任何人再伤害她！

say:4:1422117001:1.text: In fact, I know that nothing can be done about this. I, too, will soon transform...
say:4:1422117001:1.source_cn: 其实我知道，一切都已经无济于事了，我也马上就要……

say:5:1422117002:1.text: Please help free us from this agony.
say:5:1422117002:1.source_cn: 请你们帮我和她解脱吧……

say:6:1422117003:1.text: My consciousness has started to blur. I can only remember a few things...
say:6:1422117003:1.source_cn: 我的意识已经开始模糊不清了，我现在只能记得……

say:7:1422117004:0.text: I remember what Elsa said to me that time...
say:7:1422117004:0.source_cn: 只能记得那时艾莎对我说过的话……

say:11:1422117005:1.text: Oh, my loving Lolde. I promise you I'll be yours forever.
say:11:1422117005:1.source_cn: 洛尔迪，我答应你，我愿意成为你的爱人！

say:12:1422117006:0.text: Elsa...! Truly? Do you not care about all things that stand in our way?
say:12:1422117006:0.source_cn: 艾莎……！你真的愿意？！你不介意那些阻挡着我们的东西了吗？

say:13:1422117007:1.text: Of course, I care. But I know that I need to follow my heart!
say:13:1422117007:1.source_cn: ……介意，但是我知道，我们都要诚实地面对自己！

say:14:1422117008:1.text: With this ring as our bond, we'll never forget, never drift apart, and never betray one another.
say:14:1422117008:1.source_cn: 以戒指为证，我们永不遗忘，永不逃避，永不背叛……

say:17:1422117009:0.text: Never forget, never drift apart, and never betray one another...
say:17:1422117009:0.source_cn: 永不遗忘，永不逃避，永不背叛……

say:18:1422117010:1.text: Please, I beg you! While I still remember, end our pain!
say:18:1422117010:1.source_cn: 求你们了，趁我还能记得这些，结束我和她的痛苦吧！

say:19:1422117011:1.text: If I had the chance to do it all over, I'd make sure we never crossed paths. Maybe then she wouldn't have suffered because of me...
say:19:1422117011:1.source_cn: 如果能重来，我希望我们从未相遇，这样我就不会给她带来那...

cinematic_dialogue:22:1422116002:.text: Get away from her! She's corrupted!
cinematic_dialogue:22:1422116002:.source_cn: 让开！洛尔迪！她已经孽化了！

cinematic_dialogue:22:1422116003:.text: I won't let anyone hurt her again!
cinematic_dialogue:22:1422116003:.source_cn: 我不允许任何人再伤害她！

narration:24:14022131:0.text: Lolde stands in front of Elsa as she begins to turn. With no other choice, Indris knocks him down. Remembering their past together, Lolde pleads with you all to end their suffering. Then, he turns as well.
narration:24:14022131:0.source_cn: 洛尔迪挡在孽化的艾莎面前，因度厄无奈将其击倒。洛尔迪回...
narration:24:14022131:0.male: Lolde stands in front of Elsa as she begins to turn. With no other choice, Indris knocks him down. Remembering their past together, Lolde pleads with you all to end their suffering. Then, he turns as well.

narration:25:14022131:0.female: Lolde stands in front of Elsa as she begins to turn. With no other choice, Indris knocks him down. Remembering their past together, Lolde pleads with you all to end their suffering. Then, he turns as well.

cinematic_dialogue:2:1422118001:.text: Lolde and Elsa... You are free...

say:8:1422119002:0.text: These rings belong to Lord Lolde and Elsa... Their names are engraved on them.
say:8:1422119002:0.source_cn: 这是……艾莎和洛尔迪的对戒，上面刻着他们的名字……
say:8:1422119002:0.male: These rings belong to Lord Lolde and Elsa... Their names are engraved on them.
say:8:1422119002:0.female: These rings belong to Lord Lolde and Elsa... Their names are engraved on them.

say:9:1422119003:0.text: The words on them carry love and blessings... but all they brought was misfortune to Elsa...
say:9:1422119003:0.source_cn: 说什么上面带着魔力和祝福……可给艾莎带来的却全是不幸……

say:11:1422119004:0.text: Now that it's come to this, I'll take Lord Lolde's ring back and report everything to Lady Rosalind.
say:11:1422119004:0.source_cn: 事已至此，我只能拿着这枚洛尔迪的戒指回去复命了。

choice_prompt:13:1422119004.text: Now that it's come to this, I'll take Lord Lolde's ring back and report everything to Lady Rosalind.
choice_prompt:13:1422119004.source_cn: 事已至此，我只能拿着这枚洛尔迪的戒指回去复命了。

say:14:1422119005:0.text: Yes, but it's my responsibility as the captain of the guards.
say:14:1422119005:0.source_cn: 会，但这是身为卫队长必须承受的。
say:14:1422119005:0.male: Yes, but it's my responsibility as the captain of the guards.
say:14:1422119005:0.female: Yes, but it's my responsibility as the captain of the guards.

say:15:1422119006:0.text: Elsa... she must have known this was a possibility when she accepted Lord Lolde's love. But she loved him anyway, even if it meant this would be the price. And now... she's gone.
say:15:1422119006:0.source_cn: 以我对艾莎的了解，在接受洛尔迪爱情的那一天，她就想到这...

say:16:1422119007:0.text: Magister, I want to put Elsa's ring back where it belongs.
say:16:1422119007:0.male: Magister, I want to put Elsa's ring back where it belongs.
say:16:1422119007:0.female: Magister, I want to put Elsa's ring back where it belongs.

cinematic_dialogue:18:1422118001:.text: Lolde and Elsa... You are free...

narration:20:14022132:0.source_cn: 洛尔迪的身体逐渐消散，有什么东西从他身上掉了下来，落在地上。

subtitle:1:1422121001:.text: The ring bearing Elsa's name is thrown to where they pledged their love and disappears without a trace...
subtitle:1:1422121001:.source_cn: 刻有艾莎名字的戒指被投入二人曾经的定情之地，倏忽间便消失无痕……

subtitle:1:1422121002:.text: ...like a teardrop in water, seamless and silent, as though it were never there.
subtitle:1:1422121002:.source_cn: 如同艾莎的存在一般，如同水消散于水中。
